scope: Read-only examination of existing SDK built images/configuration/symbol map and their driver dispatch source; no new stock-board boot was performed

fallback.behavior: If no PHY driver matches the Clause22 device, attach genphy_driver explicitly
fallback.conclusion: This SDK image does not execute rtl8211f_config_init; it preserves hardware vendor-page defaults rather than applying that unbuilt source function

init_changes: disable PHY-mode EEE at page0xa43 reg0x19 bit5
explicit RGMII RX/TX delay bits selected by DTS
mainline.aldps: No realtek,aldps-enable property, so hardware setting is preserved
mainline.clkout: No realtek,clkout-disable property, so hardware setting is preserved

source_comparison.gmac4_reset: Both dwmac4_lib.c implementations set DMA_BUS_MODE_SFT_RESET and poll with 10000us delay/1000000us timeout
source_comparison.clause22_mdio: Same MII_BUSY/address/clk_csr encoding and before/after busy polling (100us/10000us); new source splits read_c22/read_c45 and updates runtime-PM API
source_comparison.standard_aneg_master_slave: genphy_setup_master_slave and genphy_check_and_restart_aneg source bodies identical

runtime_driver_rebinding.conclusion: Ordinary sysfs bind is not equivalent to the internal genphy fallback; do not use blind unbind/bind as a recovery-free experiment

candidate_reversible_test.description: Preserve all other settings and temporarily set page0xa43 reg0x19 bit5, verify readback, restore original page; no BMCR reset. Later restore only that saved bit. This is a hypothesis test, not a confirmed fix

root_vco_audit.sdk_nm_m_field: not defined; zero factor normalized to 1 by ccu_nm_recalc_rate
root_vco_audit.mainline_mult_equivalence: N register field plus one, no M division; equivalent when SDM disabled
root_vco_audit.scope: Source and existing SDK DTB examination plus previously recorded warm-reboot register value; not a new board or cold-boot measurement

soft_reset_audit.other_realtek_entries_with_callback: RTL8226/RTL8221 variants; not this exact model
soft_reset_audit.rtl8211f_clkout_conditional_reset: Only when realtek,clkout-disable is set; absent for this board
soft_reset_audit.standard_ethtool_restart: genphy_restart_aneg sets BMCR_ANENABLE|BMCR_ANRESTART and clears BMCR_ISOLATE; no BMCR_RESET and no config_init call
soft_reset_audit.conclusion: No hidden second BMCR reset following the 150ms GPIO release wait in the reviewed current board configuration

artifact_provenance_limit.interpretation: Built-image evidence establishes this SDK artifact path, not the exact user previously flashed image without its SHA
